svg.text: Reproducible stages: Data Preprocessing -> Hyperparameter Tuning -> Model Export

div.style: color: #C0CAF5; font-family: monospace; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap;

foreignObject.div:
stages: prepare: cmd: python src/data_preprocessing.py --input data/raw/dataset.csv --out data/processed/ deps: - src/data_preprocessing.py - data/raw/dataset.csv outs: - data/processed/train.csv - data/processed/test.csv
train: cmd: python src/train_model.py --config params.yaml deps: - src/train_model.py - data/processed/train.csv params: - model.n_estimators - model.max_depth - model.min_samples_split outs: - models/random_forest_clf.pkl metrics: - metrics/eval.json: cache: false
evaluate: cmd: python src/evaluate.py --model models/random_forest_clf.pkl deps: - src/evaluate.py - models/random_forest_clf.pkl - data/processed/test.csv plots: - metrics/roc_curve.json: template: roc x: fpr y: tpr
